x: John Bicourt ran well to gain 4th place in a field of high quality, and he was ably supported by the fast improving Ron Hayes and Bill Bruce.

Bill Bruce then did a last-leg stint reminiscent of fellow Scot, Bill Kerr; and to everyone's pleasure took two further places with a time faster even than Ron Hayes---which is no mean feat in these "days of Hayes"!

In the Youths, Adrian Major, Ron Hayes, Bill Bruce and more recently Derek Hurd have shown considerable potential and if they maintain their progress they could well be strengthening the senior ranks in a few years time.
